mechanism: Celecoxib (CYP3A4/2C9 substrate) may inhibit praziquantel metabolism via CYP3A4, potentially increasing praziquantel levels, while NSAIDs can reduce praziquantel efficacy and increase GI bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for praziquantel efficacy and adverse effects; consider alternative antiparasitic if interaction is clinically significant; use lowest effective celecoxib dose and ensure adequate GI protection.
